description: NaNd(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.56 Å. Nd is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nd, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Nd and one C atom.
